defect: the generated clock names clk0_i as master although the mux is fixed to clk1_i
rationale: The fixed selection passes clk1_i to mux_clk. Using clk0_i as the generated-clock source assigns state_q the wrong period and source relationship.

mutation.description: Used clk0_i as the generated-clock source even though the fixed mux selection passes clk1_i.

author: gpt-5.6-luna
